title: Eagles reportedly bringing back TE Zach Ertz amid MCL injury that's expected to sideline Dallas Goedert for multiple weeks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles reportedly bringing back TE Zach Ertz amid MCL injury that's expected to sideline Dallas Goedert for multiple weeks
sources.description: Philadelphia Eagles tight end Dallas Goedert sustained a sprained MCL in Sunday's win over the Tennessee Titans and is expected to miss multiple weeks, ESPN reports.
